verdict.rationale: Bugbot documents organization-wide rules that team admins create in Bugbot Automations, and Bugbot Teams advertises advanced rules and settings. That covers pushing central review defaults. However, per-repo customization is documented only as in-repo `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files, and nothing shows exceptions being managed centrally or scaled across hundreds of repos. Missing for 10: central per-repo exception/override management, documented enforcement or inheritance of org defaults across many repos, and independent corroboration of org-scale rollout.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I roll out org-level review defaults across hundreds of repos and manage exceptions centrally

citations.quote: Team admins can also create organization-wide rules in [Bugbot Automations](https://cursor.com/automations/from-cursor/bugbot).
Bugbot Teams includes code reviews on all PRs, analytics and reporting, effort level controls, and advanced rules and settings.
Create `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files in your repository to give Bugbot project-specific review guidelines.
